symptom: `brain list --json` reports open questions with kind "decision" (and `--kind decision` returns them), so a tool counting decisions counts every open question twice (ako/PizzaV1's overview had to filter `open: true` out by hand)
cause: List set each entry's kind with EntryKind(), which reads an open question as a decision; the stored form has no question kind
insight: Give the listing a reporting-only kind (KindQuestion) for open entries rather than a stored kind: EntryKind() keeps reading them as decisions for every internal consumer, and the JSON and --kind filter stop conflating them
